description.value:
This silver ring carries a faceted sapphire framed by fine golden arcs. When you shape a spell, a faint thread of light steadies its course toward your target.

While wearing the ring, you gain a +3 item bonus to spell attack rolls. The ring does not require investment. This bonus applies only to spell attack rolls; it does not increase spell DCs or damage, weapon attack rolls, or impulse attack rolls. As an item bonus, it does not stack with other item bonuses to the same roll.

This homebrew item is the spellcasting counterpart to a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.rvItjGQaYT7Luwtm]{Weapon Potency (+3)} rune, sharing its level and price. It does not hold weapon property runes.

You can upgrade a spell potency ring to a higher-bonus version if you have that version's formula. The upgrade costs the difference between the two versions' prices: 900 gp from +1 to +2, or 8,000 gp from +2 to +3.

Craft Requirements You are legendary in Crafting.
